title: KAKA CRIED ON THE SAN SIRO PITCH. THEN MILAN BEAT INTER 3-1
description:
Hall of Fame night, derby day, and Kaka in tears on the pitch.

Milan inducted Kaka into the Hall of Fame on the pitch before the derby. A full San Siro watched him cry. Nobody blamed the onions.

Diego Moreira wore Kaka's number 22, scored a free kick and thanked him for the number. Free number, free kick. Milan won 3-1.

Kaka's next move: suggesting an old Shevchenko chant for Christian Pulisic, who is in good form. The chant consultant is working. Raphinha now wears the Brazil number 10 that Kaka wore at the 2010 World Cup. No pressure, Raphinha.

In the video game, Kaka is rated 124. Real Kaka is a chant consultant. The pixels are doing better.

Does Pulisic deserve a Shevchenko-style chant? Vote in the comments.
